explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem's content is about the library's own definitions: `hankelIdeal`, `hankelMinor`, `reduceExponent`, `outerExponent`, `innerExponent` and `MinorIndex`, which set up the Hankel-minor ideal of the rational normal curve. Mathlib has no such ideal or reduction step. The proof writes the difference as a monomial times one of the library's own Hankel minors. It uses only generic Mathlib facts (`tsub_add_cancel_of_le`, `monomial_add_one`, `mul_sub`, `Ideal.mul_mem_left`) together with the library's lemmas `monomial_outer_sub_inner` and `minor_mem`. None of these Mathlib facts carries the theorem's mathematical content, so I did not run a further name search.
